answer_verbatim: Option 1: Allow a newly born site to give birth before it is written to, matching the warm and large-growth test results. Two caveats for the panel to check: unwritten newborns must still pass the local allow/require gate so branching stays coherent and 3D-capable, and their eventual write events must still balance cleanly under the -2 / +2 ledger accounting.
decision: An heir may give birth before it is written, provided it passes the local ALLOW/REQUIRE gate. Its later write must balance under the PD-10 ledger (-2 per edge record against +2 per Birth).
